flagged.title: Human Rights, Equality and Freedom of Religion
flagged.reason: The video incorrectly claims that Reform Judaism in Britain and America affirmed same-sex marriage and conducted ceremonies starting in 1990 (F2), confusing the 1990 US decision to ordain openly gay rabbis with same-sex marriage recognition (2000 in the US, 2014 in Britain).

mark_affecting.quote: In fact, the Reform movement in Britain and America has affirmed it since 1990, and they've been conducting ceremonies ever since.
